g.text: Level-pool routing couples continuity to stage–storage and stage–outflow relations

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Same linear reservoir as1101: S=20,000h m³ and O=S/7,200 m³/s; K=2 hours. Stage is above the empty-storage datum. Uniform pool elevation is assumed;
evaporation, seepage, lateral inflow, backwater, and emergency spillway behavior are omitted. Actual routing needs a validated storage curve and outlet
